message:
Thanks, Melissa!

Nels, I'm curious as well to hear about your visiting professors from Herat. From what I understand, the place has a bad reputation because of the excesses of the religious police there -- I wonder especially how concerns with morality and religion (which I do think can and must be a force for positive change in Afghanistan if those concerns can take a turn away from fundamentalism, and even if they don't, there's still such a huge gap between what people say is moral or immoral and what they do) play out in relation to language use. (What would your visitors say about Nietzsche's "On Truth and Lies in a Nonmoral Sense" when applied to the problems of village politics?)
